title: Nullish coalescing vs OR
starterCode:
const zero = 0
const emptyStr = ""
const falseVal = false
return {
  orZero: zero || "default",
  nullishZero: zero ?? "default",
  orEmpty: emptyStr || "default",
  nullishEmpty: emptyStr ?? "default",
  orFalse: falseVal || "default",
  nullishFalse: falseVal ?? "default"
}
